newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Bank Canada approves trust amendment.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank Canada approves trust amendment.

text.p: Royal Bank of Canada said on Tuesday that its board approved amendments to the terms of a trust indenture allowing the bank to offer holders of some subordinated debentures the right to exchange them for term notes.

The bank said that the offer was subject to the approval of Canada's superintendent of financial institutions and the sanction of 66-1/3 percent of the debenture holders to which it would make the offer.

Royal said it would hold a meeting on August 20 for holders of 10.8 percent debentures due June 1, 1998, 10.9 percent due January 15, 1999, 10.2 percent due October 14, 1999, 11 percent due July 1, 2000, 11 percent (AJR) due July 1, 2000, 11.75 percent due January 31, 2001, 10.75 percent due August 15, 2001, 11 percent due January 11, 2002, 10.5 percent due March 1, 2002, floating rate debentures due July 29, 2005, 9.3 percent debentures due June 8 2023 and floating rate debentures due October1, 2083.
